```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(ggplot2)
set.seed(2195)
```

## Part 1(a)

```{r functions_a}
target_density <- function(x) {
  0.5 * exp(-abs(x))
}

log_target_density <- function(x) {
  log(0.5) - abs(x)
}

rw_metropolis <- function(N, s, x0) {
  x <- numeric(N + 1)
  x[1] <- x0
  
  for (i in 2:(N + 1)) {
    x_star <- rnorm(1, mean = x[i - 1], sd = s)
    log_r <- log_target_density(x_star) - log_target_density(x[i - 1])
    log_u <- log(runif(1))
    
    if (log_u < log_r) {
      x[i] <- x_star
    } else {
      x[i] <- x[i - 1]
    }
  }
  
  x
}
```

```{r run_a}
N_a <- 10000
s_a <- 1
x0_a <- 0

chain_a <- rw_metropolis(N = N_a, s = s_a, x0 = x0_a)
samples_a <- chain_a[-1]

mc_mean <- mean(samples_a)
mc_sd <- sd(samples_a)

summary_a <- data.frame(
  Statistic = c("Sample mean", "Sample standard deviation"),
  Value = c(mc_mean, mc_sd)
)

summary_a
```

```{r plot_a}
plot_df_a <- data.frame(x = samples_a)

p1a_plot <- ggplot(plot_df_a, aes(x = x)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)),
                 bins = 50,
                 fill = "skyblue",
                 color = "black",
                 alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_density(color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  stat_function(fun = target_density,
                color = "blue",
                linewidth = 1,
                linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Random Walk Metropolis Samples",
    subtitle = "Histogram, kernel density estimate, and target density",
    x = "x",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p1a_plot
```

```{r save_plot_a}
ggsave("part1_r_plot_a.png", plot = p1a_plot, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```

## Part 1(b)

```{r functions_b}
compute_rb <- function(chains) {
  J <- nrow(chains)
  N <- ncol(chains)
  
  Mj <- rowMeans(chains)
  Vj <- apply(chains, 1, function(z) mean((z - mean(z))^2))
  
  W <- mean(Vj)
  M <- mean(Mj)
  B <- mean((Mj - M)^2)
  
  sqrt((B + W) / W)
}

generate_chains <- function(N, s, init_vals) {
  J <- length(init_vals)
  out <- matrix(0, nrow = J, ncol = N)
  
  for (j in seq_len(J)) {
    out[j, ] <- rw_metropolis(N = N, s = s, x0 = init_vals[j])[-1]
  }
  
  out
}
```

```{r run_b}
N_b <- 2000
s_b <- 0.001
J_b <- 4
x0_b <- 0
init_vals <- rep(x0_b, J_b) 

set.seed(2195)
chains_b <- generate_chains(N = N_b, s = s_b, init_vals = init_vals)
rb_0001 <- compute_rb(chains_b)

rb_result <- data.frame(
  s = s_b,
  J = J_b,
  N = N_b,
  Rb = rb_0001
)

rb_result
```

```{r rb_grid}
set.seed(2195)
s_grid <- seq(0.001, 1, length.out = 120)

rb_grid <- sapply(s_grid, function(s_now) {
  chains_now <- generate_chains(N = N_b, s = s_now, init_vals = init_vals)
  compute_rb(chains_now)
})

rb_plot_df <- data.frame(s = s_grid, Rb = rb_grid)
head(rb_plot_df)
```

```{r rb_plot}
p1b_plot <- ggplot(rb_plot_df, aes(x = s, y = Rb)) +
  geom_line(color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "darkgreen", size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.05, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Rb over a grid of s values",
    x = "Proposal standard deviation s",
    y = "Rb"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p1b_plot
```

```{r save_plot_b}
ggsave("part1_r_plot_b.png", plot = p1b_plot, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```
